title: Associations of Plasma Folate and Vitamin B6 With Blood DNA Methylation Age: An Analysis of One-Carbon Metabolites in the VA Normative Aging Study | The Journals of Gerontology: Series A | Oxford Academic
abstract: April 30, 2021 - In the present analysis, we address this research gap by investigating the relationships of 4 plasma one-carbon metabolites (vitamin B6, vitamin B12, folate, and homocysteine) with blood DNA methylation age measures .
